function_question: How does nature hold ground against water?

opening.text: There was a girl called Lina who lived in Seaside Bay, a little town with a long sandy beach and tall dunes.
Lina walked along the beach after school, collecting shells and watching the waves roll in and out.
After a stormy winter, Lina saw that the dunes had shrunk again. "If the waves keep taking our sand, one day there will be no beach at all!"

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: The shrinking dunes
chapters.line: Lina looks at the dunes and wonders: how can we stop the sea taking our sand?

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Lina asks for help
chapters.line: Lina has a bucket full of questions, and she needs a teammate. What about you?

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The nature heroes
chapters.line: You and Lina go down to the shore to meet plants and animals that hold their ground.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: The secret of slow water
chapters.line: The heroes share the secret they all use.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Training in the sand lab
chapters.line: Every hero needs training. Lina hands you a tray of sand and a jug of water.

chapters.label: Chapter 5½
chapters.title: The last two letters
chapters.line: Lina points at a plain concrete sea wall. Time to SCAMPER it!

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: The plan
chapters.line: Every great barrier starts as a drawing.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The big test
chapters.line: Twenty waves roll in. You fix one thing, and try again.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: The beach survives
chapters.line: The winter storms come and go, and the dunes start growing again.

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Lina wants to save her beach, but a giant concrete wall isn't the answer. Can you help her? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some engineers already have a spark of an idea. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Nature solved this long ago. Tap each card to meet four nature heroes that hold their ground against water!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which barrier will save the most sand?
guide.sketch: Time to draw your barrier from above and from the side, like a real engineer!
guide.build_and_test: Build your beach and let's see how much sand your barrier saves from 20 waves!
guide.retry_tip: Engineers never stop at round 1. Change ONE thing and test again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, YOUR barrier has guarded Seaside Bay. The dunes grow a little every year, and Lina still collects shells on the beach she helped save!

quick_check.question: A beach with no barrier loses 12 spoonfuls of sand. Lina's beach loses 3. How many spoonfuls did the barrier save?
quick_check.right: Right! 12 take away 3 is 9. Comparing with a no-barrier beach is how you prove your barrier works!

clue_cards.name: Marram grass
clue_cards.trick: Long, tangled roots and tough leaves.
clue_cards.does: The roots bind the sand together, and the leaves slow the wind so sand piles up.

clue_cards.name: Mangrove tree
clue_cards.trick: Tangled stilt roots standing in the sea.
clue_cards.does: Breaks up waves and traps mud, slowly building new land.

clue_cards.name: Oyster reef
clue_cards.does: Slows the waves down before they reach the shore.

clue_cards.name: Beaver
clue_cards.trick: Builds dams from sticks, mud and stones.
clue_cards.does: Slows the river down so mud settles behind the dam.

predict.explain: A flat wall bounces the wave's energy back and stirs up the sand. Rough, gappy barriers break the wave up, so the water slows down and drops its sand.

lab.title: The sand slope lab
lab.predict: Which barrier will save the most sand from 500 ml of water?

tool.name: SCAMPER
tool.intro: SCAMPER is a set of magic question words. You already know S, C, A, M and P. Today you'll learn the last 2 letters, E and R, and finish the whole set!

parts.name: Eliminate
parts.what: Take something away and see what happens.
parts.example: 🫖 No teabags: the leaves sit in a strainer built into the pot.
parts.starter: What if the sea wall had no concrete at all, just…

parts.name: Reverse
parts.what: Flip it, turn it around or do it backwards.
parts.example: 🫖 Upside down: a pot that pours from a tap at the bottom.

sketch_checklist: I drew my barrier from above and from the side.
I showed where the waves hit and how my barrier slows them.
I showed what holds the sand in place.

test.check_question: Does your barrier stay in place after 20 waves?

reflection.question: Which nature trick helped your barrier most?
